SVM for a young programmer

Imagine a road between two groups of dots.

SVM draws the widest straight road it can. The center stripe is the separator. The road itself is the margin, where this demo asks for further diagnostic testing.

Use the graph to learn, not to diagnose.

CDC lists fasting plasma glucose of 99 mg/dL or below as normal, 100–125 as prediabetes, and 126 or above as the diabetes threshold. Diagnosis usually requires confirmation. BMI can add risk context but cannot diagnose diabetes. Pregnancy, symptoms, medicines, age, and other health information can change what testing is appropriate.
